verified_facts.text: Domes Zeen Chania is a resort on Crete's rugged coastline, close to Chania.
verified_facts.excerpt: Domes Zeen Chania is an exclusive resort experience on Crete's rugged coastline that combines the best of both worlds – close to Chania but hidden enough

verified_facts.text: The resort is beachfront, with a private beach offering complimentary loungers and umbrellas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Domes Zeen Chania is a true beachfront resort where you can relax, reconnect with friends and family through relaxation, sunbathing, and watersports. Our beautiful private beach will host all your unique moments, and complimentary loungers

verified_facts.text: The signature Soma Spa is outdoors and offers a variety of ancient rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature outdoor Soma Spa provides a variety of ancient rituals designed to relax and rejuvenate your body, mind, and soul.

verified_facts.text: The Gym Pavilion has cardiovascular equipment, free weights, strength equipment and Reformer Pilates beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fitness center includes equipment such as Cardiovascular Equipment, Free Weights, Reformer Pilates beds, and Strength Equipment

verified_facts.text: The resort has an outdoor main swimming pool and an outdoor children's pool.
The Kids Club is supervised by Montessori-inspired, qualified staff.
verified_facts.excerpt: Always supervised by a Montessori-inspired, highly creative, qualified staff

verified_facts.text: KiEpos is an eco-conscious concept for young guests, who plant and learn about vegetables, insects and flowers under expert guidance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Planting, decorating and learning all about veggies, insects, and flowers under the guidance of our experts

verified_facts.text: The resort offers guided walking tours of Chania's old town.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore Chania's rich and varied history on a walking tour of the old town

verified_facts.text: The resort offers hiking tours through Samaria Gorge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The world-renowned Samaria Gorge awaits your visit on this exciting hiking tour

verified_facts.text: Experiences include ceramic workshops guided by ceramics professionals.
verified_facts.excerpt: our carefully curated Ceramic Workshops, with the expert guidance of ceramics professionals trained in this ancient craft

verified_facts.text: Experiences include wine and olive oil tasting sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Have a sneak peek behind the rituals of olive oil and winemaking, and enjoy exclusive tasting sessions

verified_facts.text: ENINO is the resort's wine-themed degustation restaurant, where private wine tastings with tapas-style Greek mezedes pairings are held.
verified_facts.excerpt: our private wine tasting followed by an amazing tapas-pairing of local flavors (Greek mezedes), will surely leave you speechless, along with the unique setup of ENINO, our wine-themed degustation restaurant

verified_facts.text: Experiences include visits to organic Cretan beauty brands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a revitalizing journey through our organic Cretan beauty brand visits

verified_facts.text: The Koumpania Alfresco Live Station serves koumpania, a traditional Greek donut ball with honey.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our special treat for you is the extremely fresh koumpania – Greek donut ball with honey; a traditional recipe that dates back ages.
